definition: An AgentRun is a single end-to-end execution of an AI agent, from the moment it starts processing an input to the moment it produces a final result or fails.
notes: An AgentRun is not the agent's definition (prompt, graph, or code) itself
An AgentRun may fail, succeed, or be canceled
An AgentRun typically contains one or more ToolCalls and ModelInvocations
examples: A single OpenAI Agents SDK run
One turn of a customer support agent handling a ticket
counterExamples: The agent's system prompt or graph definition
A single LLM completion call (see ModelInvocation)
